notes: Sliders = AdvancedLivePortrait editor values (blink < 0 narrows the eyes, eyebrow > 0 raises, smile < 0 = corners down, aaa = mouth open, pitch > 0 = chin down). kp = raw keypoint offsets [index, axis, value] (14 y+ flattens the mouth corners, 20 y- lifts the upper lip). left / right = screen sides, added on top of both. onset = strength of the first frame, release = a number (part of the peak) or its own settings. Built-in set: 13 common expressions; users add their own in the Expression Studio.

styles.name: A 微笑
styles.en: a warm smile: mouth corners lift, cheeks rise, eyes soften

styles.name: B 抿嘴笑
styles.en: a small closed-lip smile, lips pressed together, eyes slightly narrowed

styles.name: A 仰头大笑
styles.en: a big open laugh: mouth wide open, eyes squeezed into crescents, head tips back

styles.name: B 笑出声
styles.en: laughing out loud: wide smile with the mouth open, eyes crinkled

styles.name: A 低头羞笑
styles.en: a shy smile: eyes drop away, head lowers and tilts, mouth corners lift softly

styles.name: A 睁眼张嘴
styles.en: eyes widen, brows shoot up, mouth drops open

styles.name: B 倒吸一口气
styles.en: a small gasp: eyes widen, brows lift, lips part a little, head pulls back

styles.name: A 惊恐
styles.en: fear: eyes wide, brows high and tense, mouth stretched open, head pulls back

styles.name: B 紧张
styles.en: nervous fear: brows lifted, eyes wide and darting aside, lips pressed thin

styles.name: A 怒目
styles.en: anger: brows pulled down hard, a fixed glaring stare, mouth corners pulled down, chin lowered

styles.name: B 咬牙
styles.en: furious: brows down, eyes narrowed to a glare, teeth clenched and bared

styles.name: A 低头难过
styles.en: quiet sadness: brows tilt up, heavy eyelids, eyes look down, mouth corners droop

styles.name: A 抬眼忍泪
styles.en: inner brows rise and pinch, eyes glisten and look slightly up to hold the tears in, lips press together, mouth corners pull down

styles.name: B 低头抿嘴
styles.en: head lowers, heavy eyelids, brows tense upward, lips pressed into a trembling pout

styles.name: A 放声哭
styles.en: crying openly: brows pinched up, eyes squeezed shut, mouth open and pulled down

styles.name: B 啜泣
styles.en: sobbing quietly: brows up, eyes nearly shut, lips trembling and turned down, head lowered

styles.name: A 无奈苦笑
styles.en: a wry, helpless smile: brows lift and tilt, eyes tired, a weak smile, head slightly lowered

styles.name: B 单边苦笑
styles.en: a one-sided bitter smile: one mouth corner lifts while the other stays flat, eyes slightly narrowed

styles.name: A 撇嘴嫌弃
styles.en: a scornful huff through the nose: upper lip lifts on one side, head tilts, eyes half-lidded

styles.name: B 冷眼嫌弃
styles.en: eyes narrow into a cold stare, brows lowered, chin lifted, one mouth corner tightens into a thin half smile

styles.name: A 撇嘴
styles.en: a sulky pout: lips pushed forward, mouth corners pulled down, brows slightly lowered

styles.name: A 呲牙
styles.en: a teeth-baring grin: lips stretched wide showing clenched teeth, eyes slightly narrowed
